What actually moves the group

Safety is the glue

The posts that travel furthest are crash warnings and gear reminders: "wear your gear, make it home." In the last 28 days, one rider down alert pulled 70 comments and 21,000+ views.

They ride, together

Weekend group rides run all season, Woodstock, Upper Delaware, Jones Beach and the annual Halloween ride, organized in the feed and split into fast, intermediate and beginner groups. One ride announcement drew 51,000+ views.

Rookies land here first

New riders introduce themselves constantly, first bike, fresh license, MSF course done, and get welcomed in. One new rider intro pulled 92 comments and 494 reactions.

This is what the feed looks like in real life.

Bikes bar to bar, riders shoulder to shoulder. Sportbikes, adventure bikes, cruisers and everything between, parked up on a Manhattan block.

No dead days. Engagement holds all week long, and peaks on weeknight and weekend evenings, when riders are off the road and on their phones. Sunday at 7 PM is the busiest hour of the week.
